user.title: Tiered / TOU Electricity Rate Calculator
user.description:
Configure your fixed-rate electricity plan. Designed for North America, Caribbean, Latin America, Asia & Africa.

Turn on **Has solar panels** if you have solar (Enphase, etc.) and a grid meter (Shelly 3EM, etc.). The integration will create Home Consumption, Grid Import/Export and Solar Production sensors automatically.

data.name: Name
data.has_solar: I have solar panels (create net-metering sensors)

solar.title: Solar & Grid sensors
solar.description:
Point to your existing sensors. The integration will calculate Home Consumption for you.

**Solar sensor**: Enphase production (prefer power in W).
**Grid sensor**: single net power from your meter, OR leave empty and fill multi-phase.
**Multi-phase (Shelly 3EM)**: comma-separated entity IDs, e.g.
sensor.shelly_phase_a_power,sensor.shelly_phase_b_power,sensor.shelly_phase_c_power

Example from your graph: Solar 5414 W, Grid exporting 3849 W → Home Consumption ≈ 1565 W.

data.solar_is_energy: Solar sensor is cumulative energy (kWh) instead of power (W)
data.grid_sensor: Grid net power/energy sensor (optional if using phases)
data.grid_is_energy: Grid sensor is cumulative energy (kWh) instead of power (W)
data.export_rate: Feed-in / export rate (currency per kWh, 0 = none)

source.title: Energy source sensor
source.description: Select the cumulative energy sensor (kWh) that represents what you are billed for.

tiers.title: Consumption Tiers (Increasing Block)
tiers.description:
Enter tiers as max_kWh:rate pairs, comma-separated.
Aruba Elmar example: 500:0.3431,1000:0.3531,99999:0.4645
Mexico CFE-style: 75:1.12,140:1.37,99999:4.00

tou.title: Time-of-Use Periods
tou.description:
Enter periods as name|start|end|rate|weekdays_only separated by semicolons.
Jamaica JPS example: peak|18:00|22:00|0.35|true;partial|06:00|18:00|0.28|true;offpeak|22:00|06:00|0.22|false

error.invalid_tiers: Could not parse tiers. Use format: 200:0.25,500:0.32,99999:0.41
error.invalid_tou: Could not parse TOU periods. Use format: name|HH:MM|HH:MM|rate|true/false;...
